page_title: VAL 2-1 CEL | Valencia v Celta Vigo 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+9' Vicente Guaita pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
90+8' The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
90+8' The corner from Jose Gaya (Valencia) is intercepted by the defence.
90+7' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+5' Jose Gaya (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
90+4' Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
90+2' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
90' Pepelu (Valencia) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
88' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is behind the touchline and Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
87' Today's match ends for Carlos Dominguez who will be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo).
87' Here is a change. Enzo Barrenechea is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
87' Carlos Corberan has decided to make a change. Fran Perez (Valencia) replaces Diego Lopez.
86' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
81' Dimitri Foulquier comes off the pitch to be replaced by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia).
80' Javi Guerra just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Pepelu (Valencia) replaces him.
78' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

76' Valencia slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
74' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
73' Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out for a corner. Celta Vigo can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Celta Vigo are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
70' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Williot Swedberg and he is replaced by Iker Losada (Celta Vigo).
70' Substitution. Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Franco Cervi walks off.
69' 2 - 1 An excellent first touch by Javi Guerra (Valencia), who collects a splendid pass and from the edge of the box slams the ball into the top right corner!

68' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
67' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
67' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
67' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pablo Fuertes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Valencia have a free kick.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Duro leaves the pitch and Umar Sadiq (Valencia) comes on.
65' 1 - 1 Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.

64' Diego Lopez (Valencia) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
63' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

60' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Giorgi Mamardashvili, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
60' Luis Rioja (Valencia) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
58' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Borja Iglesias will be replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).
58' Substitution. Fran Beltran is replaced by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
57' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
54' Celta Vigo are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
53' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The linesman signals a throw-in for Valencia.
50' Diego Lopez (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball has crossed the sideline. Valencia are taking a throw-in.

48' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Celta Vigo.
47' Wonderful movement by Celta Vigo. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 0 Luis Rioja (Valencia) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball inside the left post. What a wonderful strike!

43' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
42' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
40' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

38' Javi Guerra (Valencia) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
36' Hugo Duro (Valencia) commits a foul during an attacking move.
34' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
31' Hugo Duro (Valencia) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
29' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.
28' Celta Vigo keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
27' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
26' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
25' Andre Almeida (Valencia) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. It's a throw-in for Valencia.
22' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
21' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
19' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

18' Luis Rioja (Valencia) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. Valencia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
16' Pablo Fuertes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) and blew his whistle.
14' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

12' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
11' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
9' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
7' Luis Rioja (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a throw-in.
5' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Pablo Fuertes blows for a foul.
4' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
2' The ball is cleared after Diego Lopez (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Celta Vigo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Pablo Fuertes was nominated as the referee for this game.
